ruling.recommended_action: Refund $2.76 to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) for the unexplained off-route segment; no account action against the driver.
ruling.reasoning:
Route-review of a RydeTAXI trip: the trip is metered, so extra kilometres reach the fare, and RD-1 requires each off-route segment to be screened under RD-3 / RD-4 / RD-5 [F3][RD-1]. The trace settles that one off-route segment exists (18:46–18:52, 3.50 km driven against 1.54 km on the optimal route, +1.96 km) and that no qualifying RD-4 incident sits on the replaced stretch — the only feed items are speed bands 5 on East Coast Parkway and Airport Boulevard, and a band alone does not exempt [F3][F9][F10][F11][RD-4].

The driver's account is a claim, not consent: it appears only in his post-trip statement ("breakdown on the route … I took another way"), and the fact table records no in-app chat at all, let alone a rider message agreeing to the route before 18:46:55 [F7][F8][RD-5]. A complete chat record with no rider agreement before the segment counts against exemption, and there is no rider-named stop in this segment either, so neither RD-3 nor RD-5 excuses it [F7][F3][RD-3][RD-5]. The segment therefore counts and the extra distance is refundable under RD-2.

The segment's own extra km is 1.96 km (3.50 − 1.54) [F3]; measured against the fare record's own excess of 2.17 km billed at $3.06, I award the segment's share. Rate = distance fare ÷ distance km = $33.33 ÷ 23.64 km = $1.4099/km [F6][F4][RD-2]. 1.96 km × $1.4099/km = $2.7634 → $2.76. (The remainder of the billed excess — 2.17 − 1.96 = 0.21 km, about $0.30 — is corridor/matching mileage not attributed to any segment and is not refunded under RD-2.) No prior upheld route dispute exists in 90 days, so no account flag follows [F14][RD-6].

Safety screen: I read the complaint, the (empty) chat record and the driver's statement in full — no threats, intimidation, harassment, sexual remarks or dangerous-driving allegations; a route/traffic explanation is not abuse [F7][F8][F12][SAFE-1]. Evidence is sufficient: GPS segments, fare breakdown and the chat record are all present and settle every element above [F3][F4][F6][F7].

segment_findings.reason: No rider message before the segment start (18:46:55) agrees to this route — the chat record contains no messages at all, and the driver's post-trip statement of a breakdown/alternative way is a claim, not rider consent [F7][F8][RD-5][RD-3]. The RD-4 branch fails because no qualifying incident lies on the replaced stretch (speed band alone is not enough) [F11][F9][RD-4], so the segment's extra kilometres are unexcused and refundable under RD-2.
